desc:
Product page SEO titles and descriptions decide how your items look in search results and whether shoppers click. Ecom Swift LLC rewrites the search title, meta description, heading, product text and image descriptions, and applies them directly in your store.

## What is product page SEO?

Product page SEO is the work of making each product page clear to search engines and persuasive to shoppers. It covers the search title, the meta description, the main heading, the product text and the descriptions attached to images. Each page gets its own wording, built around a real search phrase.

It is different from general site optimization because it works one page at a time. A store with a hundred products has a hundred small chances to match a specific search.

## Why default product pages hold you back

Most stores publish products with whatever text arrived first. The title is the product name and brand, the description is copied from a supplier, and the images have names like "IMG_2045". Dozens of other sellers use the same supplier text, so search engines see the same page over and over and have no reason to prefer yours.

Variants add another problem. A shirt in five colors can produce five pages with the same title, which then compete with each other instead of supporting each other.

## How better product pages affect clicks and orders

The search title and meta description are your advertisement in the results. A title that names the product type, the key feature and the brand plainly gets more relevant clicks than a bare code. A good description answers the shopper's question before they click.

Once they arrive, clear headings, honest product text and well described images help them decide. Original wording also gives search engines a reason to treat your page as a distinct result. The effect varies with competition and with how many of your pages are improved, so we describe the work and never promise a position.

## What strong product page SEO includes

- A search title that names the product and one useful detail.
- A meta description that reads as an invitation, not a keyword list.
- A single clear heading that matches the product name.
- Original product text that answers common questions.
- Image alt text that describes what the photo shows.
- Variant pages with distinct titles where they deserve separate results.
- Links to related products and the parent collection.
- A short question and answer section on key products.
- The main keyword used naturally, once or twice, never stuffed.

## How we apply the changes

We take your list of products, check each against a real search term and write new text for every page. We apply the changes inside your store and send a sheet showing the old and new wording, so you can compare or reverse anything you dislike.

The Basic package rewrites search titles and descriptions for your top products and checks headings. The Standard package covers more pages, improves product text, adds image descriptions and related product links. The Premium package covers a large part of your catalog, expands product text, fixes variant and duplicate titles, adds short question sections on top products and delivers a style guide for future products.

We write original text and never copy from suppliers. Add-ons include more products, collection intro text and extra product FAQs.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Put the most important words at the start of the title.
- Describe what makes each product different.
- Write alt text for people who cannot see the image.
- Keep titles short enough to show in full on a phone.
- Use the same brand voice across every page.

**Avoid:**
- Pasting manufacturer descriptions word for word.
- Using the same title for every variant.
- Cramming a list of keywords into the description.
- Naming images with camera codes.
- Promising features the product does not have.

## Who this service is for

A store with supplier text across the catalog will see the clearest benefit, particularly dropshippers whose pages match those of many rivals. A seller with a few best sellers can start with those pages and expand later. A growing shop adding products every week can use the style guide to keep new pages consistent.

It also suits owners who have a keyword list but no time to turn it into page text.

## What we need from you

Send your product list or a store export, along with anything customers often ask about each item. If you have done keyword research, include it. We can also work without it. Add us as a collaborator or staff user so we can apply the changes in your store. We never need your password.
